facts.business: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of generic pharmaceutical products, including oral solid formulations, injectables, and APIs, with a strong international footprint and USFDA-compliant facilities.
key_risks: Commodity price risk on imported API/Intermediates/Key Starting Materials
Foreign currency fluctuation risk as a net forex earner
Regulatory compliance risk across manufacturing facilities
Cyber security incidents, breaches or data loss
Utilization of MAT credit not probable leading to unrecognised deferred tax assets
facts.related_party_note: The Company has provided guarantees and granted unsecured loans to subsidiaries. Aggregate guarantees granted during the year: Rs 381.43 crore; aggregate loans granted during the year: Rs 57.33 crore. Balance outstanding at year-end: guarantees Rs 602.64 crore; loans Rs 154.13 crore.
